notes.title: We are pleased to present the first episode of IF MODE.
notes.content:
Dear players!
We are pleased to present the first episode of IF MODE.
As a result, we've made some changes to the game, which are described below.
You can enter the IF MODE system in two ways:

From the game level.
- when unlocking IF MODE KAORU, the game will ask you if you want to continue playing true ending or you want to go to the IF MODE system.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32472406/02e42cd67cfe890a33f36bea6cd333459c04aecf.png[/img]

From the menu.
-for players who have already played the game and are only interested in IF MODE, you can have directly access via Extra -> IF MODE -> IF MODE Kaoru.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32472406/6873fe1776b9033601660f9947b7150ed4db87dd.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32472406/ab9505d7bbad03927a9cf7f0bad0e2cc407dc9e3.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32472406/780ebd95fc158cab78110e6da271ef8c2e81406f.png[/img]
We remind you that IF MODE is not canonical [that means that events from IF MODE will not be continued in the second part of the game]


Another DLC in the queue is IF MODE AKI, which we are already working on and will soon be available on Steam.

[b]Important reminder.[/b]
IF MODE add-ons come in two versions: All Age and R18 [adult version].

IF MODE Kaoru All Age
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1123700/Bloody_Chronicles_Act1__IF_MODE_Kaoru/

IF MODE Kaoru R18
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1182540/Bloody_Chronicles_Act1__IF_MODE_Kaoru_R18/

Please make sure before buying.

Thank you!

notes.title: We're rolling out the First DLC "Secret Operation" on July 15th!
notes.content:
Join Kazuki with Akito and Kaoru, who set off on 24-hour mission specially commissioned from General Coy to catch a prisoner who fled, the left hand of Togashi clan; Uzair. 
They won't be alone because new character; Inaho Asaba will join them!

Coming to Steam on [b]July 15th[/b].

https://store.steampowered.com/app/455310/

[b]Main Features:[/b]

[list]
[*] Different decisions reveal different stories and even save the life of your team.
[*] Time Events (Be fast and choose wisely, you'll see why in Episode 2)
[*] 2 new characters (Character Design: [url=https://twitter.com/comingsleep]宇枝原とま/Toma Uehara[/url])
[/list]

[b]Five new BGM's by [url=https://twitter.com/mojiro_music]Andy Hiroyuki[/url][/b]

[list]
[*] 1. Strawberry Pie
[*] 2. Crossing Thoughts
[*] 3. Tears
[*] 4. To the Truth
[*] 5. What's up?
[/list]

[list]

[h1][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33784442/5d28a84e106505dbc6e769d7dd6f6458cea3329e.png[/img]

notes.title: Upcoming update Version 1.3 "Final"
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32472406/3629dc61bbb0142b7729d1aa5d8e511fd977cbd3.png[/img]
Dear players! 
It is time! We can finally announce the new & final version of BC!
What is included in v1.3?

[b]Patch log:[/b]

[*]Added Steam Achievements
[*]Added voice for Kazuki Dad and Mother,
[*]Added new SFX,
[*]Added new Illustration,
[*]Texture glitches have been fixed
[*]Improved English translation




[b]New modern UI[/b]

The old UI was designed back in the year 2016, during that time many things have changed. We think that our old UI didn't match our requirements for the current trend on the market.
We hope you like the new UI as much as we do! 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32472406/84967cca6ccb3b051fb35389530aed2f642cf240.png[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32472406/5306057270ea4fffa34765fef4e565a1e3e4ae89.jpg[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32472406/71f71aecaced5f31e2ed67148b247935b601c1c7.png[/img]
Here some example how new UI looks like.
Additional we redesign history so navigation through history chat is now easier.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32472406/a62e5e35079be8476cf6f5355f98730aff30ff74.png[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32472406/805c8167d345324a03fafc4e29d4dda814c656e6.jpg[/img]
You can gain access to the history menu by clicking the icon on the right side.
History menu also contains a  new option- "side story," 
During your game, our new character Misato Kanie 蟹江美里 will guide you on how to unlock and manage side story panel. 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32472406/18eb79b87b12ccc1c04c523fe75e5e897a5d0d7b.jpg[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32472406/1a80634bb305e3fef8623d0e8bc2196f727a9050.jpg[/img]

Extra Menu: IF MODE and DLC.
Some time ago we announced that each character would have their own ending that we called "IF".
With this update, we added IF MODE in Extra Menu.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32472406/72bd2f20ad144be7a02d63f05fb1cca665e63236.png[/img]


Few words about IF MODE.
IF MODE is directed to the adult players only!
Story present in "IF MODE" isn't connected with the main story. It's an alternative ending of the main story.

Many players have asked us about IF Mode with secondary characters such as Eiko, Michiko or Asako. We are honored because it means players love Bloody Chronicles' story and characters as much as we do. For now, due to time and budget constraints, we must focus on IF Mode Episodes with the main cast members.
But!

We at Igrasil always listen to our fans' suggestions so, if Bloody Chronicles is a big success, we are willing to work on R18 content for Eiko, Michiko, and Asako.


So if you want to see more content of these lovely Waifu in the future, please spread the word and help us to create the best visual novel saga!
Thank you for supporting Bloody Chronicles!"
